## User outcome

Describe the user-visible problem and the simpler behavior this change delivers.

## Evidence

List the strongest test or installed-user journey that proves success and recovery.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused on one coherent user outcome.
- [ ] Failure and recovery behavior are tested without excessive isolated tests.
- [ ] English and Traditional Chinese docs are updated together where applicable.
- [ ] `make preflight` passes.
- [ ] No credentials, private project names, customer data, or generated local state are included.
- [ ] CLI, JSON, config, settings, HTTP, and extension compatibility changes are identified.
